title: 磁阻式記憶體磁穿隧接面
summary: 從MTJ 分層、STT 路徑到記憶體用途：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From MTJ stack and STT pathway to Memory application: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: MTJ 分層 → 磁各向異性
stages.description: 把「MTJ 分層」「TMR 定義」「磁各向異性」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for MTJ stack, TMR definition, Magnetic anisotropy.

steps.title: MTJ 分層：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.
steps.instruction: 畫參考層、穿隧障壁及自由層，標出讀寫端點。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Draw reference layer, barrier and free layer with read/write terminals. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
steps.observationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
steps.failure: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「MTJ 分層」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。
steps.checkEn: Submit the MTJ stack diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer.

quiz.question: 關於「MTJ 分層」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For MTJ stack, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態
只標自由層方向而不定義參考層
不註明分母便比較不同 TMR 百分比
optionsEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization
Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer
Comparing TMR percentages without denominator conventions
quiz.explanation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: MTJ 分層：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「MTJ 分層」成果，先指出錯誤主張「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding MTJ stack artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Reference-layer stability also conditions readout. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態；參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
steps.observationEn: Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization; Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.
steps.failure: 若採用「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「MTJ 分層」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「參考層穩定性也是讀值條件」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for MTJ stack, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "Reference-layer stability also conditions readout" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：參考層穩定性也是讀值條件。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: Reference-layer stability also conditions readout.

knowledge.title: MTJ 分層／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「只標自由層方向而不定義參考層」與「穿隧電阻取決於相對磁化狀態」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Specifying free-layer direction without a reference layer" is not equivalent to "Tunnel resistance depends on relative magnetization"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: TMR 定義：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「電阻比的分母必須一致」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
steps.instruction:
以假設 RP、RAP 計算 (RAP-RP)/RP 並註明慣例。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一偏壓與溫度下 MTJ 平行電阻 RP=5 kΩ、反平行 RAP=10 kΩ，TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%。若錯用 RAP 當分母會得到 50%。本例不含讀取電路雜訊或電阻分布，不能由平均 TMR 直接宣告可靠讀取。
steps.instructionEn:
Compute (RAP-RP)/RP from hypothetical values with the convention stated. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume MTJ resistances measured at the same bias and temperature are RP=5 kΩ and RAP=10 kΩ. TMR=(RAP−RP)/RP=100%; incorrectly using RAP as denominator gives 50%. Noise and resistance distributions are absent, so mean TMR does not establish reliable reading.
steps.observation: 電阻比的分母必須一致；RA 需註明有效接面面積。
steps.observationEn: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent; Resistance-area values need effective junction area.
steps.failure: 若採用「不註明分母便比較不同 TMR 百分比」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Comparing TMR percentages without denominator conventions", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「TMR 定義」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：電阻比的分母必須一致。
算例驗收：驗算 100%，標示分母 RP，並畫出兩態分布可能重疊的情況。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the TMR definition diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: The resistance-ratio denominator must be consistent.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 100%, label RP as denominator and sketch a possible overlap of the two state distributions.
